nodes.short_description:
The Great Maze Challenge
A fun VR puzzle game where you explore and navigate through a twisting 3D maze. Start at the entrance, find your way to the finish.  Simple controls, immersive design, and a relaxing seated experience make it perfect for quick play sessions.

Early Release: Get in early and avoid price rises! The Great Maze Challenge is under rapid development — upcoming features include a scoring system, leaderboards, timers, traps, treasure, and collectible badges.

nodes.change_log:
## Version 4.4.5
**Release Date:** April 21, 2026

### Dedicated Menu Scene

#### Menu Scene Split
- **`Menu.unity`** added as a standalone scene that runs before `AmazingMaze.unity`.
- The start menu (maze size selection, music toggle, breadcrumbs toggle, smooth/snap turn) now lives entirely in the Menu scene; the game scene is loaded clean on Start with settings passed via `GameSettings.Current`.
- `AmazingMaze.unity` no longer contains any menu UI hierarchy, reducing scene complexity and eliminating stale-canvas issues on restart.
- `ProjectSettings/EditorBuildSettings.asset` updated to include both scenes in the build order (Menu = 0, AmazingMaze = 1).

#### GameSceneBootstrap (new)
- **`GameSceneBootstrap.cs`** reads `GameSettings.Current` at game-scene startup and applies: maze file selection, music enabled state, smooth/snap turn preference across all `ControllerInputActionManager` instances, and FFR enable.
- `[DefaultExecutionOrder(200)]` ensures it runs after all managers are initialized.
- Calls `GameManagementInput.RebuildMazeWithResource(mazeFile)` to kick off the maze build.

#### StartMenuUI Rewrite
- `StartMenuUI.cs` rewritten to operate as a pure Menu-scene component.
- Maze-size selection buttons (Small / Medium / Large / Insane / Castle / Tower) with checkmark visuals.
- Music, Breadcrumbs, and Continuous-Turn toggles persist via `GameSettings`.
- Right-stick turn works directly in the Menu scene (both continuous and snap) without requiring XRI locomotion providers - uses raw Input System bindings bypassing the XRI layer entirely.
- `GameHasStarted` static flag prevents double-start on scene reload.

#### MenuSceneSetup Editor Tool
- **`Assets/Editor/MenuSceneSetup.cs`** - editor utility to auto-configure the Menu scene hierarchy and XR Origin settings.

#### MenuBackdropMat
- **`Assets/Maze/Menu/MenuBackdropMat.mat`** - new dark backdrop material for the menu scene background panel.

---

### XR Menu Ray Interaction Fix

#### NearFarInteractor Position Correction
- Both `Left_NearFarInteractor` and `Right_NearFarInteractor` prefab instances had large scene-level local position overrides (Left: 20.3, -1.36, 50.4; Right: 26.2, 0.22, 1.51) placing the ray origin tens of metres from the controllers.
- All position overrides reset to `(0, 0, 0)` in `AmazingMaze.unity`; interactors now originate correctly from the controller transform.
- `m_ExtendLineToEmptyHit: 1` confirmed set on `Left_NearFarInteractor.prefab` so the beam renders to its full cast distance when no target is hit.

#### StartMenuCanvasConfigurator Improvements
- `StartMenuCanvasConfigurator.cs` updated with additional runtime safety: forces `RenderMode.WorldSpace`, fixes sub-0.0005 scale, assigns UI layer recursively, dynamically adds `TrackedDeviceGraphicRaycaster` via reflection, removes `StandaloneInputModule`, and patches all interactor interaction-layer masks including inactive `NearFarInteractor` instances (uses `FindObjectsInactive.Include`).
- `[DefaultExecutionOrder(-450)]` ensures it runs before any UI interaction.

#### BeamDiagnostic (new)
- **`BeamDiagnostic.cs`** auto-injected into every scene via `[RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(RuntimeInitializeLoadType.AfterSceneLoad)]`.
- Logs `NearFarInteractor` world/local position, `LineRenderer` material/shader/positionCount, `CurveVisualController` state, and interaction layer bits at Start and at 1 s / 3 s / 6 s / 10 s intervals.

#### BeamMaterialFixup (new)
- **`BeamMaterialFixup.cs`** corrects `LineRenderer` material assignments at runtime if the beam material is missing or incorrect.
- **`Assets/XR/StarterAssets/Materials/BeamLine.mat`** - new dedicated line renderer material (transparent, vertex-colour, ZTest Off).

#### InteractorEventMonitor (new)
- **`InteractorEventMonitor.cs`** subscribes to all `XRBaseInteractor` hover, select, UI-hover, and region-change events at runtime.
- Periodic state dumps log `enabled`, `active`, `selectionRegion`, `uiEnabled`, `farCast`, `hovering`, and `selecting` for each tracked interactor.
- `[ContextMenu]` actions allow immediate dumps from the Inspector.

#### UI Toolkit Integration
- `Assets/UI Toolkit/PanelSettings.asset` and `UnityDefaultRuntimeTheme.tss` added for UI Toolkit world-space panel support.
- `Assets/UI/Menu.uxml` - UI Toolkit XML panel used in the menu prototype.

---

### 3D Printable Maze Models (4.3)

#### Python Print Pipeline
- **`ascii_to_stl_tower_v3.py`** - converts ASCII tower maze floors to printable 3MF geometry with configurable wall height, cell size, floor thickness, and dowel holes.
- **`build_tower_all_floors_v3_3mf.py`** - assembles all 10 floors into a single stacked 3MF model with alignment pins.
- **`build_tower_exploded_dowel_3mf.py`** - generates an exploded-view model with separate floor plates joined by dowels for assembly reference.
- **`build_tower_stacked_2dowels_3mf.py`** - compact stacked variant with two-dowel columns.
- **`small_maze.3mf`** - complete single-floor small maze print file.

#### Print Output Files
- `tower_all_floors_v3.3mf` - all-floors stacked model (~431 KB).
- `tower_exploded_dowel.3mf` - exploded-dowel assembly model (~183 KB).
- `tower_stacked_2dowels.3mf` - 2-dowel stacked model (~190 KB).
- Tower 3D print source files reorganised into `Assets/Maze/Resources/Mazes/3dPrint/Tower/` subfolder.

---

### Forearm Hand Models (4.3)

- **`Hand_Forearm_Left.fbx`** and **`Hand_Forearm_Right.fbx`** added under `Assets/HandyHands/Models/`.
- **`Hand_Forearm_Left_Prefab.prefab`** and **`Hand_Forearm_Right_Prefab.prefab`** created with correct rig hierarchy.
- **`CreateForearmHandPrefabs.cs`** and **`SwapForearmHandsInScene.cs`** editor tools added to automate prefab creation and in-scene swapping.

---

### Scoreboard Improvements (4.3)

#### Monospaced Leaderboard Font
- **`CourierNew.ttf`** and **`CourierNewBold.ttf`** added under `Assets/TextMesh Pro/Fonts/`.
- `CourierNew SDF.asset` and `CourierNewBold SDF.asset` generated and placed in `Fonts & Materials/`.
- `PlayFabTimePlacard` and `PlayFabScorePlacard` updated to load `CourierNew Bold SDF` at runtime (falls back to `CourierNew SDF`, then `LiberationSans SDF`).

#### Column-Aligned Leaderboard Display
- Position, name, and time/score columns now align correctly across all entry widths.
- Names clamped to 24 characters; `<mspace=0.55em>` TMP tag applied to force uniform character width.
- Pad calculation: longest "pos. name" prefix measured across all entries; each row name padded with spaces to that width before the time column.
- Text alignment set to `TopLeft` with adjusted `textLocalPosition` for better board placement.

#### Scoreboard Bug Fixes
- `HallOfFamePlacard.cs`, `PlayFabScorePlacard.cs`, `PlayFabTimePlacard.cs` minor fixes for null-entry handling and retry logic.

---

### Tower Maze Layout Corrections (4.3)

- All 10 tower floor files (`tower.txt` through `tower_9.txt`) corrected - wall and corridor geometry verified against the final in-game layout.
- Corresponding solver maps (`Solver/tower.txt` through `Solver/tower_9.txt`) regenerated to match.
- Tower 3D print source files updated in parallel with the solver corrections.

---

### CastleFloorVisibility Refactor (4.3)

- `CastleFloorVisibility.cs` major refactor with configurable `adjacentFloorBuffer` (default 3, required for tower ramp sight lines), `checkInterval`, `floorThickness`, `levelHeight`, and `minFloorsRequired` inspector fields.
- Wall prefix tables extended to cover `Floor3` through `Floor9` and `MazeRoof` for full tower support.
- Lift-suspension logic: culling pauses while the tower lift is in motion so all floors remain visible during travel.
- `FormerlySerializedAs` attributes preserve existing scene data for the renamed `hysteresisUp`/`hysteresisDown` fields.
- `FloorIndicator.cs` fix applied to correct floor-number display during rapid floor transitions.

---

### Developer Tools (4.3)

- **`Assets/Tools/Get-PlayerActivity.ps1`** - new PowerShell tool that queries PlayFab for recent player login and leaderboard activity, useful for monitoring live build engagement.

---

### Cleanup (4.3)

- `Assets/Resources/PerformanceTestRunInfo.json` and `PerformanceTestRunSettings.json` removed (unused test artefacts).
- `Assets/StreamingAssets/RuntimeActionBindings.json` removed (superseded by asset-based input actions).

---

### Build
- Bundle version incremented to 4.4.5 (Android bundle code 445).
